question_text: The Tax Reform for Acceleration and Inclusion (TRAIN) Law, signed in 2017, restructured the Philippine tax system to make it simpler and fairer. It lowered personal income tax rates for most taxpayers while expanding the value-added tax (VAT) base and increasing excise taxes on fuel, sugar-sweetened beverages, and automobiles. The law also raised the threshold for VAT exemption on gross sales from ₱1.9 million to ₱3 million. In the context of the passage, what does 'threshold' most nearly mean?
